scope: Official publicly readable 2024 spell descriptions; audit inventory only, not a completed runtime spell library.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

spells.name: Shield
spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell
